suggestions.description: Rewrite the 18 import edges that incorrectly point to themselves. The source file should import from the actual target (e.g., src/lib/supabase/server.ts, src/lib/StreakContext.tsx, etc.). Use the file content to determine correct import targets.

Add 'api-call' edges from StreakContext functions to the API routes they call (login, checkin, habits, achievements, badges, history, notifications, profile). This is the primary data flow in the app.
Convert all 17 'code' type nodes and 2 'markup' type nodes to 'file' type. Add 'code' or 'markup' as a tag instead to distinguish them within the schema.
Add edges from components that use the browser Supabase client (if any) to src/lib/supabase/client.ts.
Add 'renders' edges from parent components (page.tsx:Home) to all view components they render, and from view components to sub-components they use.
Remove the ~15 'uses' edges from file nodes to their own exported functions where 'exports' edges already exist. Convert to 'calls' edges from parent components instead.
Use consistent edge ID format, always include weight, and use 'label' consistently instead of mixing 'label' and 'description'.
